test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**The given sentence contains a grammatical error. Identify the segment that contains the error.**

I will join you tomorrow if I will have time.
solution:
The erroneous part is** 'will have time'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The given sentence is an example of the first conditional.
 
• In type 1 conditional sentences, the tense in the "if" clause is the simple present tense, and the tense in the main clause is the simple future or the simple future.
 
• 
 
 
 

 If clause(condition)
 Main clause(result)
 
 

 If + simple present
 simple future
 
 

 If my father doesn't pick me up
 I'll take the bus home.
 
 
 
 
 
• *Example: *
 
 
• *If he works hard, he will surely get the job. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a779acc017790d2eea790cc9122762921b180090c4a6901b9133fe30db56bd.png] *
 
• *If he works hard, he would surely get the job. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b91b169c9a6aba309887b5e1410c56688829831001bc1448ed23f1bec5eca1d8.png] *
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2. 

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I will join you tomorrow if I **have** **time**.*
